messages:
Elena Rodriguez: customer ticket #3602: they saw two charges when their streaming request retried after a transient network error. this one included a toolcall.
Ravi Shah: do we have evidence the toolcall executed twice? that affects refunds.
Elena Rodriguez: logs show toolcall webhook delivered once, but billing shows provisional tokens from both the partial stream and the resumed stream.
Tess Huang: ah
anger
rea: we currently record provisional grants per-route and finalize on segment.confirm. if retry goes to a different route we get two provisional rows.
Ben (billing): with toolcalls we cannot auto-dedupe. finance/legal won't allow silent merges if side effects might have happened.
Liz (console): short-term UI fix: add a "provisional" badge and show route_id + raw telemetry link on each ledger row. that will help support triage.
Ravi Shah: telemetry change: emit stream.session.client_id when present, stream.segment.grant with segment_id, and toolcall.invoked boolean on provisional events.
Tess Huang: agree. server should accept X-Client-Session header for streaming, documented in SDKs. recommend SDKs preserve across retries.
Elena Rodriguez: customer used a non-official SDK so no session header.
Ben (billing): proposal for refunds: manual review if toolcall.invoked=true. if toolcall=false and session_id matches, auto-collapse provisional within 90s window. otherwise flag as "possible retry duplicate" in UI for support.
Liz (console): I'll add a filter for "possible retry duplicate" using those heuristics and surface the telemetry links. ETA 48hrs for a quick patch.
Ravi Shah: RFC note: billing pipeline reconciliation can later add a conservative dedupe pass that writes an audit record. include a rule: never auto-merge entries that include toolcall.invoked or external webhook receipts.
Tess Huang: small router change: attach route_id to provisional charge events so we can show origin. low-risk.
ops-bot: reminder: add billing-dedupe RFC to next oncall agenda.
Elena Rodriguez: I'll reply to customer with interim explanation and promise clearer ledger UI + follow-up.
Ben (billing): looping in legal/ops for the refund—the logs and webhook evidence will guide outcome.
